szoveg_eredeti:
Zero data retention (ZDR) with Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS) is now in public beta for eligible businesses. It looks for misuse across many requests while remaining compatible with ZDR.

We developed it with over 100 customers.

Read more: https://claude.com/resources/articles/zero-data-retention-with-enterprise-frontier-safeguards
